tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background for every Spear surface: documents, slides, site. The default ground.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables and panels that sit on `paper`.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Quiet bands: callouts, table header rows, the key-figure strip on a report cover.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy, the logo and every primary mark. Reads on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `paper-sunken` (15:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, sources, footnotes, table labels. Reads on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `paper-sunken` (5.6:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and table dividers that carry no meaning on their own. Never for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and button borders, focus rings, chart axes: lines that must be seen. 3:1 or more on `paper` and `paper-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: signal-up
tokens.usage: Positive figures in financial tables and charts only (growth, profit, go). Always paired with a sign or word (+12%, Go); it is the same lightness as `signal-down`, so colour alone never carries the meaning.

tokens.name: signal-down
tokens.usage: Negative figures in financial tables and charts only (losses, cost overruns, no-go). Always paired with a sign or brackets ((4.2), −8%, No-go).

families.arabic: "Thmanyah Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Geeza Pro", sans-serif
families.arabic-display: "Thmanyah Serif Display", "Thmanyah Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", serif
families.arabic-serif: "Thmanyah Serif Text", "Thmanyah Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Report and deck covers. One line, two at most.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles inside documents; the finding, not the topic.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: One headline number per page or slide (valuation, raise, break-even month).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, sources, footnotes, table cells in dense models.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above titles and on covers. Always uppercase, always tracked.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Numbers in tables; set with tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) and right-aligned.

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Arabic covers and section openers: Thmanyah Serif Display Bold. Black 900 only for a single word or figure on a cover.

styles.name: ar-title
styles.usage: Arabic page titles: Thmanyah Serif Text Medium.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.usage: Arabic running text: Thmanyah Sans Regular; one size up from `body`.

styles.name: ar-small
styles.usage: Arabic captions and sources: Thmanyah Sans Light.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between paragraphs, table cell padding, card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between blocks on a page.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page margins on documents and slides; space above a section opener.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Cover margins. Spear is generous with space: when unsure, step up.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The default. Cards, tables, images, buttons, slides: Spear is cut, not rounded.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and small tags only, to soften a hard edge on screen.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips in trackers (Go / Hold / No-go). Nothing else.
